_comment: flywheel factory event log. OPT-IN: pg-log.sh exits immediately unless ~/.local/state/pg-factory/ exists, so installing this plugin changes nothing until you run `mkdir -p ~/.local/state/pg-factory`. Only the six events both Claude Code and Droid document are registered, so one file serves both harnesses. Two PostToolUse entries by design: Droid matches tool names as exact strings with `*` as its wildcard, Claude Code treats the matcher as a regex and matches everything when it is omitted.
